name: open_design_dashboard_spec
audience: customer technical review and sales engineering demo

visual_direction.density: high information density on dark panels with gold hierarchy and restrained data accents

components.role: customer ROI calculator for selected candidate
annual saving and payback result cards
sticky narration progress and mode toggle
clipboard export for selected candidate decision package
risk closure task board linked to selected candidate
customer decision talk track and value path
ROI sensitivity matrix for conservative current and upside assumptions

review_checklist: The first viewport must show product identity, selected recommendation, API state, and next section hint.
Black-gold theme must keep chart labels and controls readable on dark surfaces.
Charts must remain legible at 390px mobile width without horizontal overflow.
Customer-facing Chinese labels must fit inside controls and cards.
Design must preserve engineering evidence links and avoid unsupported production claims.
Weight simulator and compare mode must read as decision tools, not decorative panels.
Solution drilldown must keep benefit, risk, delivery, and evidence tabs wired to the selected candidate.
Business case calculator must stay linked to selected candidate and update from assumption sliders.
Presentation mode must preserve black-gold theme and guide benefit, drilldown, ROI, and evidence sections.
Decision pack export must include selected candidate, gains, business case, ranking, evidence, and disclaimer.
Benchmark board must keep candidate cards clickable and explain family-level route positioning.
Closure board must keep voltage, demagnetization, iron-loss, and bench validation tasks visible.
Delivery health panel must expose API, OpenDesign, evidence, interaction, and export readiness.
Meeting script must stay linked to selected candidate, ROI assumptions, workload weights, and risk closure.
Stage gate board must translate recommendation into workload freeze, FEA/material review, HIL/bench entry, and decision-pack review.
Sensitivity matrix must show conservative, current, and upside ROI scenarios and keep cards clickable into ROI assumptions.
Algorithm maturity matrix must keep model, data, interface, validation, and customer value visible for every algorithm row.
Evidence gap priority board must rank voltage, demagnetization, iron-loss, and HIL/bench evidence by customer decision impact.
Review question board must map customer questions to selected candidate, ROI, evidence gaps, and next actions.
Decision pack preview must connect selected candidate, ROI, evidence gaps, review questions, and next actions before export.
Customer minutes generator must turn selected candidate, ROI, evidence gaps, review answers, and stage gates into Chinese action items.
Validation action timeline must map T+3/T+5/T+7/T+10 actions to owners, evidence outputs, customer value, and dashboard refill targets.
Validation risk heatmap must rank voltage, demagnetization, iron-loss, and HIL/bench risks by impact, urgency, owner, and refill target.
Customer acceptance gate must combine decision pack completeness, ROI, validation timeline, risk heat, and customer confirmation into clear Chinese sign-off conditions.
